[Question]
Please ask Xiao Hong to count, how many apples do they guess they buy?

[Candidate Answers]
A. After Xiao Hong counts, she guesses there are 22 kinds of apples.
B. After Xiao Hong counts, she guesses there are 24 kinds of apples
C. After Xiao Hong counts, she guesses there are 29 apples.
D. After Xiao Hong counts, she guesses there are 26 apples.
